produce_block_v4_bid_beacon_api.highlight: Proposal: VC contacts builders directly, supplies bid to connected Beacon nodes via ProduceBlockV4 extension
Concerns: adds complexity to VC, may enable undesirable off-protocol markets; Nico notes payload attributes timing mismatch and late-slot API call issues
If bid rejected by Beacon node, falls back to P2P bid or local build (best-effort inclusion)
No consensus to merge; Jihoon suggests continued async design discussion targeting Hoodi

epbs_missed_slot_payment_ordering.highlight: Two competing PRs (consensus-specs #5694, #5695) address payment when builder wins bid, exits, and slot is missed
Nico's PR #5695 preferred by Michael (Lighthouse) and accepted by Potuz; stricter request ordering deemed safer for future extensions
Merging #5695 constitutes a consensus-breaking change; requires new CL spec release; Potuz to open Prysm PR

gloas_beacon_api_prs.highlight: 6 open Gloas-related beacon-API PRs (#638, #641, #655, #657, #659, #615); Nico has approved all and implemented in Lodestar
Goal: merge before Sepolia fork; implementations ready for Hoodi

focil_client_images.highlight: FOCIL images available for Lodestar and Teku; Lighthouse working on it; Prysm status pending
